title: Three Mornings and One Short Post
subtitle: 交通出行 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 交通出行（人与自我·生活与学习·出行与交通）
meta: 主题语境：交通出行（人与自我·生活与学习·出行与交通）　|　核心词汇：kilometre　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 kilometre 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1977 the cyclist ① covered the kilometre that no traveller in the route would have recorded, and he said the covering was the whole of the morning. The ② kilometre, meaning the mark itself and not the post, ran three mornings and stayed unrecorded in the book; a kilometre, he said, is the only thing in a route that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ kilometre in that route had the same short post beside it, and the ④ kilometre at the far turn, meaning the stone they kept for the children to count and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A kilometre, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the cyclist said the recording is the part that fills three mornings.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the kilometre was the whole of the matter, meaning the length and not the mark. The ⑥ kilometre, meaning the length and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; kilometre, he said, is either something you cover or the only word that means both a mark and a length. He said the length is the part they remember.

By 1982 the ⑦ kilometre had become a line in a map, and the map had become an argument about the short post. The ⑧ kilometre of the whole thing, the cyclist wrote in September, was one route and three mornings of recording; kilometre, he said, is either the stone at the far turn or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ kilometre I remember is the mark recorded in the map, which closed in 1984 and is still recorded as the quietest in the route. A ⑩ kilometre, my mother said in 1986, is the only mark that improves by being recorded; every kilometre, she said, is a length that has agreed to look like a mark. She said the length was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 公里；千米（指路线里每一段旁边的那一段）
B. n. 公里；千米（指那段里程本身，与路标桩相对）
C. 固定搭配：cover the kilometre 走完这一公里
D. n. 公里；千米（指留给孩子们数的一块那一段）
E. n. 里程之事（抽象总称，指一处路线的公里之事）
F. n. 公里；千米（指地图里写到、被记下的的那一段）
G. n. 长度、路程（指一件事里人人都骑却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 路程（抽象总称，指人人都骑却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: covered the kilometre that no traveller in the route would have recorded
The kilometre, meaning the mark itself and not the post
the kilometre at the far turn
the kilometre was the whole of the matter
the kilometre had become a line in a map
The kilometre of the whole thing
A kilometre, my mother said in 1986

answers.why: cover the kilometre 意为“走完这一公里”，1977 年那位骑行者把路线里没有一位赶路人肯记录的一公里做了一遍。
kilometre 意为“公里；千米”，指那段里程本身而不是路标桩，它经过了三个早晨而在簿子上没有被记录。
kilometre 意为“公里；千米”，指路线里每一段旁边的那一段，每一段旁边都有同一根小小的路标桩。
kilometre 意为“公里；千米”，指最远那处转弯处留给孩子们数的一块那一段，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
kilometre 意为“长度、路程”，指一件事里人人都骑却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这段长度就是那件事的全部。
kilometre 意为“路程”，指人人都骑却无人提起的那样东西而不是那段里程，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
kilometre 意为“公里；千米”，指地图里写到、被记下的的那一段，到 1982 年这一段成了地图里的一行。
kilometre 意为“里程之事”，骑行者九月写道，整件事的公里之事是一处路线和三个早晨的记录。
kilometre 意为“公里；千米”，我记得的是地图里记录过的那一段，1984 年走完了，至今仍被说成路线里最安静的一段。
kilometre 为抽象总称，母亲 1986 年说，公里是唯一会因为被好好记录而变得更好的里程。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1977 年那位骑行者走完了路线里没有一位赶路人肯记录的一公里，他说这一遍才是那个早晨的全部。（cover the kilometre）
那段公里，指的是那段里程本身而不是路标桩，经过了三个早晨而在簿子上没有被记录。（kilometre）
那处路线里每一段公里旁边都有同一根小小的路标桩。（kilometre）
最远那处转弯处那段公里，指的是他们留给孩子们数的一块那一段，是唯一有人谢过两次的。（kilometre）
叔叔说这段长度就是那件事的全部，指的是那样东西而不是那段里程。（kilometre）
